item.title: Love at Long Last
item.content:encoded:

Genre (Optional): existential/Emotional

  • A series of messages between two Foundation personnel from parallel universes (Red universe)

  • Event Log: Gothic Storm: First known RMK-Class Scenario for both parallel worlds (Red universe)

Elevator Pitch:

+ show block
– hide block


The object is a pair of particles in between two separate branching worlds that allow for the communication between these two timelines via the transmission of information (possibly through Morse Code). A researcher by the name of Dr. Underwood attempts to contact her recently-deceased husband's counterpart in the alternate timeline, in a world where she had died rather than him during a similar event (possibly a containment breach, as both had worked together at the foundation when alive). The article contains a record of these messages, as well as documentation of cataclysmic events that transpired as a result of Dr. Underwood's attempts to reconnect with her husband.

Central Narrative:

+ show block
– hide block

Dr. Underwood's husband had recently died two years prior due to a freak accident. Underwood isolates herself to focus on her work, and makes a breakthrough in inter-dimensional communication, where she comes into contact with Dr. Chase, her husband's counterpart in another dimension. In their communication, Chase reveals that Underwood had been the one to pass in his dimension, rather than him. As they talk, massive differences between the two worlds become evident, the primary one being that Chase's universe orbits a Red Dwarf while Underwood's earth (our Earth) orbits a Yellow dwarf. Eventually, the two realize that their communication is causing their realities to bleed into one another. Chase attempts to sever their connection to keep the two worlds separate, but Underwood continues to message him. This causes both particles to combine, accelerate the fusion process between both worlds. This leads to an event known as "Gothic Storm", the first known Reality-Merging Class Scenario (RMK-Class) in that reality. The aftermath is chaotic, and leads to public awareness of the Foundation, the release of numerous anomalies, and shifts of entire galaxies in the universe. Dr. Underwood had seemingly disappeared, while Dr. Chase was discovered in her office. The document ends with an interview with Chase, and remains the only documentation of this event

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The concept of an RMK-Class Scenario hasn't been used much on the wiki before. Additionally, it (attempts to) question the ethics of sacrificing the whole for personal gain. It attempts to paint the characters as both selfish and stingy, as well as human and sympathetic. I will admit that the concept itself isn't the most original, but the story and its consequences certainly are.

Additional Notes: This isn't my original story: I received the idea from this youtube video, and tried to make a unique ending: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=K3W61Ae0M9g
